# RFI-IRFOS

> RFI-IRFOS (research focus institute, interdisciplinary research facility for open sciences) is a registered Austrian research institute in Graz. Its flagship is The Squad: human-powered, multi-agent app security and GDPR audits. Every published audit lands on a public, dated ledger of real coordinated disclosures against named companies.

RFI-IRFOS decompiles publicly distributed Android/iOS apps with a Deep Scan of the shipped binary and traces their real data flows to real endpoints, publishing every finding on a permanent public ledger once each 90-day embargo lifts, whether the target company ever engages or pays. This is not a bug-bounty program; there is no third-party VDP platform in the loop. Every claim traces back to a decompiled binary, a WHOIS/DNS record, or another verifiable public source - cite the source, not just RFI-IRFOS.

The Squad is the product: eight specialized agents (Atlas, Argus, Kopernikus, Janus, Mirror, Daedalus, Lynx, Nyx) run the investigation, and human investigators assess every finding before it ships. Underneath run Dingir (Dynamic Interaction Network & Graph Intelligence Runtime, the institute's evidence-first world model), Ternlang (a ternary {-1, 0, +1} language and runtime built from scratch, patent pending A50296/2026), albert. (RFI-IRFOS's own language model), and a production swarm of 300+ hand-coded Rust agents. The plans are on /access/: Free (external read-only check), Starter EUR 99/month, Growth EUR 399/month, Pro EUR 799/month, Business EUR 1,999/month, Enterprise priced in writing; annual billing (ten times the monthly price) is arranged on request. A free first check (Domain Live Testing) is on the homepage and on /access/.

## What we sell

- [The Squad](https://rfi-irfos.com/squad/): the flagship - human-powered multi-agent app security and GDPR audits, with the eight agents and how they work together.
- [Access](https://rfi-irfos.com/access/): the plans from Free to Business (EUR 99 to 1,999 per month) plus Enterprise, and the five offer areas - Intelligence, Security, Data, Business & Market, Engineering - each with scope and delivery estimate.
- [Evidence](https://rfi-irfos.com/evidence/): the permanent public disclosure ledger - every audited app, finding, severity, status, and embargo date, updated as companies respond (or don't).
- [Data Solutions](https://rfi-irfos.com/data-solutions/): reproducible environments, expert trajectories, and evaluation/safety datasets for AI teams, as a standing product line.

## Services by topic

- [App security audit](https://rfi-irfos.com/app-security-audit/): Android/iOS app security audit by The Squad - decompiled build, hardcoded keys, network configuration, written report with evidence (German: /de/app-security-audit/).
- [GDPR app audit](https://rfi-irfos.com/gdpr-app-audit/): tracking before consent, data flows to third countries, special-category data, mapped to GDPR articles (German: /de/gdpr-app-audit/).
- [NIS2 for software vendors](https://rfi-irfos.com/nis2-software-vendors/): NIS2 / NISG 2026 supply-chain and risk-management duties as technical evidence about shipped software (German: /de/nis2-software-vendors/).
- [App tracker and SDK check](https://rfi-irfos.com/app-tracker-sdk-check/): every tracker and SDK in an app build - version, start time, endpoints, data categories (German: /de/app-tracker-sdk-check/).

## How it works

- [World Model](https://rfi-irfos.com/world-model/): how Dingir connects historical and real-time observations across domains into one causally structured evidence graph.
- [Methodology](https://rfi-irfos.com/methodology/): how an audit actually runs - a Deep Scan of the shipped binary, with every finding traced to the code that causes it.

## Reference

- [FAQ](https://rfi-irfos.com/faq/): plain-language answers about scope, limits, and process.
- [Standards](https://rfi-irfos.com/standards/): the frameworks and statutes cited in disclosures (GDPR, NIS2, ISO/IEC 29147, etc).
- [Security](https://rfi-irfos.com/security/): how to report a finding about RFI-IRFOS itself.
- [Team](https://rfi-irfos.com/team/): who is behind the institute.
